2c853fbfab.q: What is Bonds' internal marketing mantra to maintain brand consistency and create iconic campaigns?
2c853fbfab.a: The internal mantra that all of the team lives by is 'do iconic shit.' 34f6d05a21.q: How did Bonds launch into the U.S. market with the Robert Irwin 'Made for Down Under' campaign?
34f6d05a21.a: The campaign was designed to celebrate Bonds' launch into the U.S. market and featured Robert Irwin in his underwear, taking the simple idea that Australians are laid back in the face of danger, suggesting it's because they're all wearing comfy undies. It was executed as a one-take, one-shot ad that was unapologetically Aussie and cut through in America almost overnight, going viral and appearing on the news.

8f3874d5e0.q: What key lesson did Bonds' head of marketing learn from expanding into the U.S. market?
8f3874d5e0.a: The biggest lesson was the importance of simplicity and trusting gut instinct to translate the brand. When taking Bonds to a brand new audience that had never heard of it before, the need to boil everything down to just a few core ingredients became a gift to creativity—simplicity in both strategy and craft, which also taught lessons about not overcomplicating marketing even in the home market.
